title: VerifiAgent Activity Traces
summary: Log every AI agent action as a hashed, timestamped trace on chain and derive a simple trust level from the history.
what: VerifiAgent is a small Anchor 0.29 program: one agent account per wallet plus one trace account per logged action, numbered in order.
app_note: The page at /dapps/verifiagent/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/verifiagent; only declare_id changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/verifiagent/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet, call initialize_agent and then log_activity with a 32-byte hash.
try_steps.see: An agent PDA and a trace PDA with index 0; trust level L1.
try_steps.ran: Registration, two traces and verification (see steps).

diagram: wallet --initialize_agent--> agent (L0); wallet --log_activity(hash,type)--> trace[n] + agent.total++ (trust level); anyone --verify_trace--> logs trace
accounts: trace PDA ["trace", wallet, index u64 LE]
innovation: A numbered, append-only trace per agent gives an auditable timeline of what an agent claims it did.
exercises: What would a third party need to check to trust a trace hash?
How could trust levels resist self-logging spam?
not_covered: L2 and L3 trust levels (need days of activity)
